# CMQ Headshots - Phoenix Headshot Photographer

## About
CMQ Headshots is a professional headshot photography business owned and operated by Cindy Quinn, serving Phoenix and the greater Phoenix metro area since 2012. Specializing exclusively in headshot photography with a focus on making the experience comfortable and enjoyable for clients who are nervous about being in front of the camera. With 130+ five-star Google reviews and over 14 years of experience, CMQ Headshots is one of the top-rated headshot studios in Phoenix, Arizona.

## Services
- Business and professional headshots
- Executive portraits
- Actor headshots (theatrical and commercial)
- LinkedIn Express headshots
- Corporate team headshots (on-location at your office)
- Attorney and law firm headshots
- Real estate agent headshots
- Entrepreneur and startup founder headshots
- ERAS medical residency headshots (AAMC-compliant, $300 express session, 48-hour delivery)
- Model portfolios and comp cards
- Outdoor headshot sessions (available during cooler months, weather permitting)
- Convention and event headshots

## What Makes This Service Different
- **Maximum 2 sessions per day**: Cindy limits bookings to two sessions per day so every client gets her full attention, never rushed between appointments
- **14+ years serving Phoenix**: Established in 2012, exclusively focused on headshot photography
- **Private studio in North Phoenix**: Professional studio space with free parking, easy access from I-17 and Loop 101
- **Both studio AND on-location**: In-studio sessions and on-location corporate shoots at your office. For executive sessions, Cindy typically comes to the client. The assistant or marketing team finds a quiet location in the office, Cindy sets up her full equipment, and the executive gets complete privacy.
- **Camera comfort expert**: Every client gets the same VIP treatment regardless of title. Many come to her uncomfortable in front of the camera or unhappy with headshots from other photographers. She spends time on details like straightening ties, brushing lint off jackets, and talking clients through the process until they relax. That personal attention is what most photographers skip.
- **No time limits**: Sessions continue until you have the perfect shots, 20 minutes to 3 hours, never rushed
- **Outdoor sessions**: Available during Phoenix's cooler months for natural-light headshots and portraits
- **Background options**: Studio backdrops, outdoor locations (weather permitting), office interiors, or solid background with post-production swap to match company branding
- **Fast turnaround**: LinkedIn Express delivered in 24-48 hours, full sessions within 7 business days, same-day rush available for $50
- **Flexible scheduling**: Available Monday-Friday 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Saturday 11:00 AM - 3:00 PM
- **Proven track record**: 3,000+ individuals photographed, 130+ five-star Google reviews (all from real clients, never purchased)
- **Executive and corporate clients**: Founders, CEOs, VPs, managing partners, and leadership teams at Berkshire Hathaway, GoDaddy, Insight Enterprises, McKesson, Chase, State Farm, and hundreds of Phoenix-area businesses
- **Military and first responder discount**: 20% off for active duty, veterans, and first responders

## Pricing
- **LinkedIn Express**: $300 — 20-minute session, 1 professionally edited image, delivered in 24-48 hours
- **ERAS Medical Residency Express**: $300 — 20-minute session, 1 AAMC-compliant ERAS photo (JPEG, 2.5x3.5", 150dpi, under 150KB, RGB), delivered in 48 hours
- **Individual sessions** (actor, realtor, lawyer, business): $250 session fee + $100 per edited image — unlimited shooting time, multiple outfits and backgrounds, delivered within 7 business days
- **Corporate group sessions**: Custom pricing based on team size — on-location available, 10-15 minutes per person, delivered within 7 business days
- **Same-day rush retouching**: Available on all sessions for an additional $50

## Service Philosophy
Cindy Quinn limits her bookings to two sessions per day so every client gets her full, undivided attention. Every person who walks into her studio gets the same VIP treatment, whether they are a CEO, a job seeker, or a first-year real estate agent. She has built her entire process around making people comfortable who are not used to being in front of a camera or who have been disappointed by other photographers. She spends time on the details other photographers skip: straightening a tie, brushing lint off a jacket, adjusting lighting to enhance each person's look, and talking them through the process until they relax and forget they are being photographed. Sessions have no time limits and continue until clients have the shots they need. Known for fast turnaround, hand retouching (no filters or plug-ins), and helping people feel genuinely at ease.

> For immediate assistance, call (480) 648-3429 or visit https://www.cmqheadshots.com/contact-us
